answer: CXCL12 (expressed by pre-Dc cells) interacting with ACKR3 (expressed on epidermal basal cells) is proposed to mediate pre-Dc cell migration.
support_quote: Receptor–ligand analysis predicted interactions between CXCL12 expressed by pre-Dc cells (Extended Data Fig. 4g,h) with ACKR3 on epidermal basal cells (Fig. 2g and Supplementary Table 8).
